fact: Completion sync requires a reviewed candidate and the same approved project-memory revision. The active run checks the signed Review and reports the sync result in the current Pi session.

The plugin stores a source-project mirror in .fact/<source-repository>/facts.tsv with its full owner identity and remote IDs. It establishes a local Git exclusion before writing and treats tracked files separately.
A mirror keeps explicit retirement state and version; failed queries, missing pages or absent records leave existing entries available pending reconciliation.
